detail: raw exception normalised to UNEXPECTED_ERROR: major.toLowerCase is not a function
note: A unit-name operand read off the value stack is assumed to be a string. Malformed bytecode can leave any Value type there. vm/VM.ts, the UOM band. FIXED twice over: the PUSH_NUMBER pool-index guard refuses this stream before it reaches the builtin, and vm/VMBuiltins.ts index 94 (asTwoUnits) now reads its two unit-name arguments rather than casting them, returning an UNKNOWN_UNIT Value if either is not a string.
